title.narrative: Partnering for Green Growth and the Global Goals 2030 (P4G) 2023-2027

description.narrative: 1) Businesses supported by P4G become investment ready 2) Government and private-sector leaders contribute to improving the green growth enabling systems based on inputs by P4G partnerships 3) Knowledge mobilisation (incorporating MEL) engages knowledge partner stakeholders who can influence enabling systems and country transitions in food, water and energy systems.
